action.on_failure: Keep the candidate unpromoted and retain the missing-adapter error as the active current-stage blocker. Do not use candidate fields as validated downstream inputs, substitute a legacy adapter, or add random/identity model behavior, runtime-weight loading, simulation, or golden-output prerequisites.
produces: input/case_adapter.json (promoted only after candidate checks pass)
action.rationale: No registered tool can create the missing model-family case adapter. Implement or invoke planned_tool.case_adapter_provision to assemble a candidate from the supplied model, board, tool, and sample-project materials, including real weight references, TB/RTL references, compile-only VCS/simulator protocol declarations, and diagnosis-tool bindings. The candidate must be hash/provenance bound and must exclude model-tail operations from DUT weight coverage. This is a capability implementation gap, not a hardware correctness result.
